actualVisualInspection.method: Independent reviewer physically viewed all full source pages and reran component/polygon/socket measurements; Root adopted that exact pinned evidence.
observations: Each of the five replacement mapped poses now displays one coherent PSG1, with no duplicate rifle carried behind the held weapon.

LEFT11 shoulders the PSG1, supports the fore-end and aims its barrel towardLEFT. Candidate muzzle[780.5,190.5] and rear[830.5,190.5] are visually on the barrel axis; actual event origin is not certified here.
Ready9 and reload12 retain attached receiver/stock/barrel and complete hands/body. They are quiet weapon-handling poses, not additional strike or firing moments.
Two facing-specific neutral sources preserve a whole upright crown/boot calibration, while aimed/braced poses remain naturally lower rather than stretched.
The LEFTaim page has faint top-row alpha<=5; no alpha>16 component reaches the canvas edge. This is a qualified low-alpha fringe, not proof of an opaque cut body.
